title: Funny Death Sounds
description: Funny sounds to spice up dying a bit
body:
# Variety is the spice of death Now you have even more reasons to laugh at your friends' skill issues! Adds 4 funny sounds for death, with more expected!
ResPackOpts support might be added. Look out for it! Also, this pack replaces the death sounds. If you want the sounds to be added, you gotta do a bit of tinkering.
1. Extract the zip. 2. Open assets --> minecraft --> sounds.json 3. Search for "replace": true. Set it to false. Don't forget to save it ;) No need to zip it back, it works. But if you do, do not select the folder and zip it. Select the contents inside the folder (assets folder, pack.png and pack.mcmeta), then click 'compress to zip'.
Might show a version warning, though it's safe to ignore.
Spoiler Sounds Added - 1. Ack Sound 2. Bone Crack Sound 3. Among Us Killing Sound 4. Michael Jackson 'Ow' Sound 5. Wilhelm Scream Sound 6. Slap Sound Rest assured, I have already removed the unwanted echo from the ack sound and silent parts from each one of them.
## Wanna use it? Sure! Just credit me. Feel free to give suggestions! (Sorry for the icon, it's a default icon discord sets automatically) ##Suggested! Since you have scrolled down so far, you must really like resourcepacks. So, I recommend using Resourcify and Respackopts to keep your resourcepacks company!
